o1: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity, including RNA polymerase II-specific transcription activator activity; beta-catenin binding activity; and enzyme binding activity. Involved in the establishment or maintenance of cell polarity; chordate pharyngeal muscle development; mesodermal cell fate commitment; and regulation of gene expression. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including QL; QR; hypodermis; somatic nervous system; and vulva. Is part of a noncanonical Wnt signaling pathway. Used to study obesity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer; colorectal cancer; diabetes mellitus (multiple); pancreatic cancer; and reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including TCF7L2 (transcription factor 7 like 2).
